decisions.reason: Close to the firm's established offer and low cost to keep, the option remains open while some uncertainty persists.
As an ongoing series building on established strengths, it holds option value from several models, so keep it open.
Jazz vinyl reissues are core to the firm's reissue business, and this option likely still holds value.
Although box sets carry higher inventory costs, the product fits the catalog and can be kept open until sales resolve.
With only a brief website mention and low differentiation, its value is unlikely to be realized, so abandonment is justified.
